description: A React component named OTPInput that renders a series of input fields for entering a one-time passcode (OTP). It manages focus movement between fields and aggregates input to call the onComplete callback when the code is fully entered.

methods.name: OTPInput
methods.description: React functional component that renders OTP input boxes and manages user interactions.

props.length: Optional number of OTP digits, defaults to 6.
props.onComplete: Callback invoked with the complete code when all digits are entered.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change, formats input to a single digit, moves focus to next input if applicable, and calls onComplete when code is complete.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles Backspace key to move focus to previous input if current is empty.
